title: Evaluate the Options
coreMove: Make each option stand beside the same criteria so attractiveness cannot outrun evidence.
sourcePressure: Now compare alternatives through tradeoffs, criteria, information quality, and judgment. Attractive options must be tested against evidence quality and real costs before action.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning evaluation into a scoring spreadsheet or abstract optimization exercise.
